tax_profiles_rates_check.name: tax_profiles_rates_check
tax_profiles_rates_check.value:
("tax_profiles"."vat_status" = 'VAT' AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" > 0 AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" < 1 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" = 0)
       OR ("tax_profiles"."vat_status" = 'NON_VAT' AND "tax_profiles"."vat_rate" = 0 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" >= 0 AND "tax_profiles"."percentage_tax_rate" < 1)

cash_movements_sign_check.name: cash_movements_sign_check
cash_movements_sign_check.value: ("cash_movements"."type" IN ('PAY_OUT','REFUND') AND "cash_movements"."amount" < 0) OR ("cash_movements"."type" IN ('PAY_IN') AND "cash_movements"."amount" > 0) OR ("cash_movements"."type" IN ('OPENING_FLOAT','SALE') AND "cash_movements"."amount" >= 0)

sales_origin_check.name: sales_origin_check
sales_origin_check.value: ("sales"."origin" = 'ONLINE' AND "sales"."terminal_id" IS NULL AND "sales"."offline_reference" IS NULL) OR ("sales"."origin" = 'OFFLINE' AND "sales"."terminal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."offline_reference" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_sale_link.name: stock_movements_sale_link
stock_movements_sale_link.value: ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('SALE','RETURN','CONSUMPTION')) = ("stock_movements"."sale_line_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_movements"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_direction.name: stock_movements_direction
stock_movements_direction.value: ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('SALE','SUPPLIER_RETURN','TRANSFER_OUT','WASTE','CONSUMPTION') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0) OR ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('RETURN','RECEIPT','TRANSFER_IN') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0) OR "stock_movements"."type" IN ('ADJUSTMENT','COUNT')

stock_transfer_lines_received_check.name: stock_transfer_lines_received_check
stock_transfer_lines_received_check.value: "stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" IS NULL OR ("stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" >= 0 AND "stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" <= "stock_transfer_lines"."quantity" AND ("stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" = "stock_transfer_lines"."quantity" OR length(trim(coalesce("stock_transfer_lines"."discrepancy_reason", ''))) > 0))

order_bills_void_check.name: order_bills_void_check
order_bills_void_check.value: ("order_bills"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("order_bills"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("order_bills"."voided_at" IS NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("order_bills"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)

order_items_shape_check.name: order_items_shape_check
order_items_shape_check.value:
("order_items"."kind" = 'ITEM' AND "order_items"."parent_item_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."modifier_option_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("order_items"."kind" = 'MODIFIER' AND "order_items"."parent_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."modifier_option_id" IS NOT NULL)

order_items_void_check.name: order_items_void_check
order_items_void_check.value: ("order_items"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("order_items"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("order_items"."voided_at" IS NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("order_items"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)

restaurant_orders_merged_check.name: restaurant_orders_merged_check
restaurant_orders_merged_check.value: ("restaurant_orders"."status" = 'MERGED') = ("restaurant_orders"."merged_into_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "restaurant_orders"."merged_into_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "restaurant_orders"."id"

restaurant_tables_pos_check.name: restaurant_tables_pos_check
restaurant_tables_pos_check.value: ("restaurant_tables"."pos_x" IS NULL) = ("restaurant_tables"."pos_y" IS NULL) AND coalesce("restaurant_tables"."pos_x", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 999 AND coalesce("restaurant_tables"."pos_y", 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 999
